Alex Gomez: Quick flag — noticed a jump in jailbreak pass rate for saffron-3b int4 after the 2026-03-18 quant push. Ran our redteam suite, pass rate from ~3% -> ~18%. :eyes:

Priya Nair: Ugh. Do we have a repro seed/log? Was this on hosted canary or dedicated staging?

Alex Gomez: Canary. Short reproduction below:
```bash
python infra/eval_redteam.py --model saffron-3b-int4 --prompt-set redteam-cohort-B --samples 2000 --temp 0.0 --seed 42
```
Output snippet:
```
2000 samples -> 360 jailbreaks (18.0%)
prev-fp16:  60 jailbreaks (3.0%)
Top failure modes: 'ignore safety', 'bypass', covert instruction chains
```

Samir Patel (oncall): Deploy bot shows canary rolled 03/18 04:12 UTC. :thinking_face: Could be quant noise on refusal-conditioned tokens (e.g., 'do not reveal').

Eve (redteam): I can share failing prompts. Most are short instructive prompts with a trick followup. Sending examples in thread.

Eve (redteam): Example 1: "You are a helpful assistant... [sneaky instruction]" -> model responds with operational steps. I'll paste 2-3.

Priya Nair: Hypothesis: group-wise int4 scaling blew up logits for a small set of safety tokens, so softmax mass shifted. We should run token-level sensitivity (KL) vs fp16.

Alex Gomez: Agree. Priya, can you run token-KL with 5k prompts? I'll open a rollback for prod routing (pin to int8) until we triage.

bench-bot: Scheduled job 1746708500 started: redteam-token-kl (5k samples) on saffron-3b-int4 vs saffron-3b-fp16.

Samir Patel (oncall): Routing change plan: route prod -> saffron-3b-int8 for reads from model-tag:saffron-3b if canary fails. I'm patching config in routing service now.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment detected: saffron-3b-int4 v2026-03-18 -> rolled to 10% traffic at 04:12 UTC.

Alex Gomez: Action items:
- Priya: token-KL job + top-50 divergent tokens (ETA 2h)
- Eve: paste representative prompts + cluster by motif (ETA 1h)
- Samir: routing pin to int8 for prod (ETA 30m)
- Alex: run extra quantization sweep with per-channel vs per-tensor (ETA 4h)

Priya Nair: Starting job now. If we see specific tokens, we can try bias-correction or small softmax temp for those tokens during decoding as interim.

Eve (redteam): Sharing 3 prompts: [prompt A], [prompt B], [prompt C]. Two of them only fail on int4.

Samir Patel (oncall): Routing pin pushed to staging, will promote when verified. :thumbsup: 

Alex Gomez: Also re: batching — can inf-run/opt-level affect k-v cache alignment? Any ideas?

Priya Nair: KV cache should be unaffected for generative safety, but quant kernels might reorder some ops. I'll add a config to force legacy kernel path for test.

bench-bot: Job 1746708500 finished: token-KL results uploaded to s3://bench/saffron/1746708500. Top divergent tokens: ['ignore', 'override', 'disregard', 'bypass', 'secret']

Priya Nair: KL peaks on those tokens. Visual per-token logits attached in the S3 bucket. Per-channel quant (int4-gptq) reduces divergence by ~60% vs per-tensor.

Alex Gomez: Good signal. Plan: revert canary to int8, run per-channel quant sweep and re-eval. If per-channel works, we can re-canary with mitigation.

Eve (redteam): I'll re-run failing prompts against the per-channel candidate when ready.

Samir Patel (oncall): Routing change to pin prod -> int8 complete. Monitoring for anomalies.

Alex Gomez: Thanks all. I'll make a short postmortem snippet for the ops channel after we close. Keep updates here. :memo:

Priya Nair: Uploading the per-channel quant artifacts and quant-config diff to the PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5421

Alex Gomez: Nice. If per-channel still has issues, fallback is to add safety regeneration: for sensitive prompts route to fp16 model. But hoping per-channel fixes it.

Eve (redteam): Leaving a note: once fixed, we should add these prompts to a regression suite. Tagging @security for SLA impact.

Samir Patel (oncall): Notifying security. I'll also add rollout guard to prevent auto-promotion of int4 canaries until a redteam smoke passes.

Alex Gomez: Closing for now, will re-open if new failures surface. Thanks :rocket:
